predecessors.name: Lithuania, 1918-1940 (Cliopatria's 'Kingdom of Lithuania' row)
predecessors.text: 'Vilnius and its region', which Lithuanian forces evacuated on the night of 8-9 October 1920

successors.name: Second Polish Republic
successors.text: the Republic's whole territory, 'incorporated into the Wilno Voivodeship' after the Polish Sejm accepted the request of incorporation on 22 March 1922

ledger.x: 12 October 1920: Żeligowski proclaims the Republic of Central Lithuania at Vilnius.
12 October 1920: the new state is a puppet of Poland from its founding.
7 November 1920: Żeligowski's army advances beyond Vilnius.
22 March 1922: the vassalage ends with incorporation into Poland.
March 1922: Central Lithuania is incorporated into Poland.

wars.name: Żeligowski's Mutiny
wars.outcome: Żeligowski's forces, secretly ordered by Piłsudski, took Vilnius on 9 October and proclaimed Central Lithuania on 12 October; the Lithuanians held at Giedraičiai and Širvintos in 19-21 November and a ceasefire took effect on 21 November, a truce on 29…

certainty.note: A puppet state with no treaty frontier; Lithuania refused to recognise the line, which the Conference of Ambassadors accepted in 1923 (page: recognised 'during the interwar period').
